values.note: Camping on a Virginia WMA needs a written camping authorization ($10, up to six people) from Go Outdoors Virginia or a license agent, which sets the trip's start and end dates; 14 nights at most. Only in previously cleared spots, and 'unlawful to camp within 300 feet of any lake or facility'. DWR: 'WMA roads are not suitable for long vehicles or trailers ... Some WMAs may not allow travel trailers or RVs.' Rapidan: 'Primitive camping (no developed sites or facilities) is permitted throughout the management area'. The South River tract is reached only by Taylor Mountain Road (SR 642), continuing up a dirt road past the end of state maintenance; DWR says WMA roads there 'can be rough. A four-wheel drive vehicle recommended.'

booking.source: https://dwr.virginia.gov/camping-on-wmas/ + https://dwr.virginia.gov/wma/rapidan/ (Other Activities; Maps & Directions), read 2026-10-21
